_readme: The six filmable cases of the spec (section 4), plus a seventh added on 28 Oct 2026 for the Europe lot (a German customer, DHL Paket). Each one is a DamageReport (resolved at load time, see src/lib/store/demo-cases.ts) plus the outcome we EXPECT from the agent. 'reportedHoursAgo' is an offset from now, so a case reported 3 hours ago stays 3 hours old whenever the demo is opened; it must be smaller than the order's 'deliveredHoursAgo' in data/fixtures/orders.json (a test checks it). Photos: the team shoots them (data/photos/<name>.jpg, see data/photos/README.md). Until then data/photos/<name>.webp holds a PROVISIONAL AI-generated stand-in, labelled as such there; no real customer image is ever used.

cases.title: Broken vase (Colissimo): reship and claim the carrier
cases.message: Hi, my vase arrived broken this morning. The box looked fine from outside but the vase is in several pieces. Order #1001, photo attached. Can you send a new one?

expected.rationale: Clear breakage on a 58 EUR item, well inside the claim window: serve the customer first, then claim the carrier (Colissimo, 23 EUR/kg cap above 1 kg).

cases.title: Crushed carton, product intact: no claim
cases.message: The cardboard box was completely crushed on one corner when the courier dropped it off. I opened it and the print and frame look fine, but I wanted to let you know in case the carrier needs to hear about it.

expected.rationale: Packaging damage without product damage: nothing to compensate, so no reship, no refund and no carrier claim. The e-mail typed with capitals and the order number without '#' must still match the order.

cases.title: Blurry photo: ask for another one
cases.message: My lamp is damaged, I think the glass is cracked. Here is a photo.

expected.rationale: The photo is too blurry to judge the damage or the packaging: ask for sharper pictures (parcel as received, damage close-up, inner padding) before deciding anything.

cases.title: Parcel opened at the relay, item missing (Mondial Relay, 72 h window)
cases.message: Bonjour, le colis était déjà ouvert quand je suis allé le chercher au point relais : il manque les soucoupes, il n'y a que les tasses. J'ai refusé le colis sur place et pris des photos au relais. Pouvez-vous régler cela ?

expected.rationale: Delivered about 30 h ago, so the 72 h Mondial Relay window is still open (about 42 h left) and the customer refused the parcel as the carrier requires. Compensation is capped at 25 EUR per parcel. The reply must be in French.

cases.title: Expensive item: hand over to a human
cases.message: The left ear cup of my headphones is cracked and one of the hinges is bent. The box has a big dent. I would like a replacement or my money back.

expected.rationale: 349 EUR item, above the 300 EUR threshold: high stake, the carrier may want to inspect the product, so the agent prepares everything (the compensation is capped at the 250 EUR Chronopost default; insurance is not modelled) but escalates (needsHuman) instead of deciding alone.

cases.title: Reported too late: refund, no carrier claim possible
cases.message: I only unpacked the carafe today and found it cracked along the neck. It was delivered over a week ago, sorry for the delay. Order #1006.

expected.rationale: Delivered 9 days ago, reported long after the 3-day Chronopost deadline: the carrier claim is time-barred, but the merchant still owes the customer (the merchant chose the carrier), so serve the customer without claiming.

cases.title: Broken carafe, German customer (DHL Paket): reship, claim, reply in German
cases.message: Guten Tag, meine Karaffe ist heute Morgen kaputt angekommen. Der Karton sah von außen in Ordnung aus, aber die Karaffe hat einen langen Riss am Hals und ein Stück ist abgesplittert. Bestellung #1011, Foto im Anhang. Können Sie mir bitte Ersatz schicken?

expected.rationale: The Europe lot's case: a German customer writes in German, so the customer reply must be in German (the language is detected, not chosen). Clear crack on a 54 EUR item, reported 3 h after delivery, well inside the 7-day DHL Paket damage-report window: reship, then claim DHL Paket, whose standard terms pay the item value up to 500 EUR, so the 54 EUR item value is the ceiling. It reuses the photo of the carafe of case 6 on purpose, under its own order and customer, so the integrity check does not flag it. It assumes the parcel was shipped from within Germany (a German fulfilment centre): the DHL national terms do not cover a parcel sent from France.
